This is followed by a photo of a desert-themed roller coaster with red rock formations. An animated male character in a black t-shirt appears, pointing his finger and gesturing. This transitions to a fast-paced montage of real-world roller coaster footage including steep drops and upside-down loops. A sequence shows several teddy bears seated in a wooden roller coaster car. visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 最奇怪的科學發現. [Slogan]: 坐雲霄飛車可以排出腎結石?. [Logo]: 維維維. (2) [Slogan]: 坐雲霄飛車能排腎結石?. [Subtitle]: 一個病患興奮的跑來跟醫生說. (3) [Subtitle]: 自己搭迪士尼的巨雷山雲霄飛車後. (4) [Subtitle]: 一顆腎結石就掉出來了!. (5) [Subtitle]: 而且每搭一次還會掉出一顆. (6) [Subtitle]: 醫生一聽立刻用病人的腎臟資料. (7) [Subtitle]: 變出了一個3D模型來到迪士尼. (8) [Subtitle]: 16.67%. 63.89%. 近64%!. (9) [Subtitle]: 這樣都可以? 那坐越刺激的雲霄飛車效果不是越好咯?. (10) [Subtitle]: 也不會. 醫生真的去坐了其他更刺激的. [Variety]: 結石. (11) [Subtitle]: 看來是要速度不那麼快、上下顛簸、急轉彎的車. [Subtitle]: 最適合「震出結石」!. [Slogan]: 2018年搞笑諾貝爾醫學獎喔!. (12) [Subtitle]: 但是，有腎結石還是去看醫生啦.
